news.t: Trophy exit on penalties to Waterlooville
news.x: A 1–1 draw with Waterlooville AFC in the Hampshire Saturday Trophy second round, settled 5–4 on penalties in the visitors’ favour.

news.t: Judd double as Stags see off Southsea 4–1
news.x: Ciaran Judd scored twice in a 4–1 home win over top-eight Southsea Sports, keeping the Stags in the title race.

news.t: League Cup quarter-final: Southsea Sports away
news.x: After beating Division 1 leaders Nursling & Shirley 6–1 (Judd 2), the Stags travel to Southsea Sports in the last eight on Saturday 21 November.

news.t: Whitehill & Bordon FC 3-1 Broughton: Second-Half Surge
news.x: Shayne Warren, Ciaran Judd and Ritchie Hunter scored in a 3-1 win over Broughton.

news.t: Davis double sends The Stags top
news.x: Ryan Davis scored twice as the Stags beat Crofton Saints 2-1 at The Daly Ground to go top of the Hampshire Premier League.

news.t: 🏆 ADFA Saturday Intermediate Cup Final: Binfield Dev 1–2 Whitehill & Bordon
news.x: A second-half comeback won the cup, with Dean Worman off the bench to score both goals, a header and a penalty.
